<infobox>
	<title source="title">
    	<default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
	</title>
	<image source="image">
		<default>Placeholder.png</default>
	</image>
	<header>Section Information</header>
	<group layout="horizontal">
		<data source="previous_section">
    		<label><div>Previous Section</div></label>
    		<default><span style="color: gray;">''???''</span></default>
    	</data>
		<data source="next_section">
    		<label><div>Next Section</div></label>
    		<default><span style="color: gray;">''???''</span></default>
    	</data>
    </group>
    <data source="entity_amount">
    	<label><div>Entity Amount</div></label>
    </data>
        <data source="i_entity_amount">
    	<label><div>I Entity Amount</div></label>
    </data>
     <group>
  	<group layout="vertical" show="complete" collapse="closed"></group>
  <header source="sound_info_header">Sound Files</header>
  <data source="sound1"/>
  <data source="sound2"/>
  <data source="sound3"/>
  <data source="sound4"/>
  <data source="sound5"/>
  <data source="sound6"/>
  <data source="sound7"/>
  <data source="sound8"/>
  <data source="sound9"/>
  <data source="sound10"/>
  <data source="sound11"/>
  <data source="sound12"/>
  <data source="sound13"/>
  <data source="sound14"/>
  <data source="sound15"/>
  </group>
</infobox>
